title: OpenAI fires back at Apple, publishing private emails to counter trade-secret claims
excerpt: Apple is asking a judge to halt OpenAI’s use of alleged trade secrets and speed up discovery.
content_html:
Beatrice Nolan

Tue, August 4, 2026 at 1:22 PM CDT 3 min read

OpenAI has come out swinging in its legal battle with Apple—and brought receipts.

The AI lab published a response—along with a tranche of private emails and messages—pushing back on some of the claims in Apple's lawsuit filed last month that accused OpenAI, its hardware unit, io Products, and two former Apple employees of trade-secret theft.

Apple had accused the AI lab of carrying out a coordinated effort to take confidential information about unreleased Apple products and processes. The suit includes claims alleging that a former employee who joined OpenAI took advantage of a security bug; that job candidates were encouraged to bring proprietary Apple hardware into interviews; and that OpenAI leadership effectively normalized this conduct.

OpenAI's blog post is not a legal response to the suit, but rather an effort to publicly point out flaws in some of Apple's accusations and legal process—and potentially court public opinion. 

"Apple is one of the greatest companies of all time, and built a reputation for obsessing over the smallest details," OpenAI wrote in the blog. "This careless, aggressive, and oddly personal lawsuit sadly doesn't live up to that reputation."

In what appear to be two missteps, the company says, Apple's outside lawyers emailed the wrong individual after confusing "two Asian last names," and that a purported conversation with OpenAI's general counsel "never happened."

OpenAI accused Apple of trying to hide the fact that it never raised the specific allegations in this lawsuit at that time. Instead, the lab says, Apple informed OpenAI only that it was "resolving any issues" and did not contact the lab any further until it sued.

In its lawsuit, Apple alleges that OpenAI benefited from confidential information taken by former Apple engineer Chang Liu and former design executive Tang Tan.

OpenAI counters that Apple now concedes its own employees reached out to Liu—not the other way around—and published messages it says show Apple staff asking Liu for help locating files and answering technical questions after his Jan. 22 departure.

OpenAI also argues that these emails undercut Apple's narrative that the company ignored its concerns, saying they demonstrate that OpenAI responded to Apple's outreach and that any breakdown in communication stemmed from Apple's own outside counsel.

The dispute reflects a rapidly deteriorating relationship between the two companies, which have shifted from collaboration to competition as both push into competing product areas. While Apple has been leaning on Google to integrate more advanced AI into its ecosystem, OpenAI has moved deeper into consumer devices—particularly after acquiring Jony Ive's design firm io and recruiting several former Apple staff, moves that appear to have heightened tensions.

content_html_zh:
比阿特丽斯·诺兰

2026 年 8 月 4 日星期二下午 1:22 CDT 阅读时间 3 分钟

OpenAI 在与苹果的法律诉讼中表现出色，并带来了成果。

AI 实验室发布了一份回应，以及大量私人电子邮件和消息，对苹果上个月提起的诉讼中的一些指控进行了反驳，这些诉讼指控 OpenAI、其硬件部门、io Products 以及两名前苹果员工盗窃商业秘密。

苹果指责人工智能实验室协同努力获取有关未发布的苹果产品和流程的机密信息。 该诉讼包括指控一名加入 OpenAI 的前员工利用安全漏洞的指控；鼓励求职者在面试中携带苹果专有硬件； OpenAI 领导层有效地规范了这种行为。

OpenAI 的博文并不是对诉讼的法律回应，而是公开指出苹果的一些指控和法律程序中的缺陷，并可能吸引公众舆论。

OpenAI 在博客中写道：“苹果是有史以来最伟大的公司之一，并以对最小细节的痴迷而闻名。” “遗憾的是，这场粗心、咄咄逼人、奇怪的个人诉讼并没有名副其实。”

该公司表示，这似乎是两次失误，苹果的外部律师在混淆了“两个亚洲姓氏”后向错误的人发送了电子邮件，并且据称与 OpenAI 总法律顾问的对话“从未发生过”。

OpenAI 指责苹果试图隐瞒其当时从未在这起诉讼中提出具体指控的事实。 相反，该实验室表示，苹果只是告知 OpenAI，它正在“解决任何问题”，并且在提起诉讼之前没有进一步联系该实验室。

苹果在诉讼中称，OpenAI 受益于前苹果工程师刘畅和前设计主管唐坦获取的机密信息。

OpenAI 反驳称，苹果公司现在承认自己的员工曾联系过刘强东（而不是相反），并发布了消息，称显示苹果员工在刘强东 1 月 22 日离职后，要求他帮助定位文件并回答技术问题。

OpenAI 还辩称，这些电子邮件削弱了苹果公司关于该公司忽视其担忧的说法，称这些电子邮件表明 OpenAI 对苹果的外展做出了回应，并且任何沟通中断都源于苹果自己的外部法律顾问。

这场争端反映出两家公司之间的关系迅速恶化，随着双方都进军竞争产品领域，两家公司已经从合作转向竞争。 虽然苹果一直依靠谷歌将更先进的人工智能集成到其生态系统中，但 OpenAI 已经深入消费设备领域——特别是在收购 Jony Ive 的设计公司 io 并招募了几名前苹果员工之后，这些举动似乎加剧了紧张关系。
